clean_body: | | | | | Patriot, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Patriot... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Patriot -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... We are optimistic over here and have chosen to ultimately release control of this to God. However, we have also decided to campaign as if we are 10+ POINTS DOWN and work endlessly until we've secured a conservative majority in both chambers. But we must admit... Turning Point PAC is looking to raise an additional $1,400,000 before the election to secure victory in battleground states. body:
#

Can I show you something?
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261009-1-b&refcode2=11905.3935704.fTUYeV&t=1&akid=11905%2E3935704%2EfTUYeV)
This is a replica of my skull after being shot in the head. I was at a constituent event in 2011 when I was the target of a politically motivated shooting. The gunman killed six people and wounded 12 others.
The doctors made a replica of my skull to create the titanium plate that was used to replace the part of my skull that had to be removed due to swelling. I keep it to remind myself of what I survived on that awful day in January 2011.
It’s been fifteen years since my shooting, but not a week goes by when I don’t think about it. Some days are harder than others, but I never stop fighting.
I see our fight to end gun violence the same way. There may be setbacks, but we can never lose sight of our work to save lives from the gun violence crisis.
**But too many politicians have shown that they’d rather cave to the gun lobby than fight for our families. As I write this, Donald Trump and his allies are working to roll back our progress and help their gun CEO buddies profit. Enough is enough.**
Everything is at stake in the midterm elections. I am working to rally voters and elect gun safety champions across the country, but the only way we can continue sharing our message is with your support.
**So before logging off for the weekend, I am personally asking:** [**Will you pitch in $10 or more to help GIFFORDS PAC elect leaders in the most competitive of races and power our work to end gun violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261009-1-b&t=2&akid=11905%2E3935704%2EfTUYeV)

| | | | Good morning, Peter! It’s Cait. I only have a few spare moments this morning before the day gets going, so please forgive the lack of polish here. Here’s what I want you to keep in mind before you start your day:
1. Our last FEC deadline is coming up, and the fundraising numbers we report are public. It’s important that we show we have the resources to compete, especially since Mike Lawler has more money than we do.
2. Donald Trump is in New York today because Republicans think that this state is their key to surviving the midterms. He has invested millions of dollars here—and is spending more on our district than on any other House race nationwide.
3. According to Nate Silver’s latest update, this is still a toss-up district. As of today, we are holding the line against this MAGA spending.

In 2024, billionaires like Elon Musk were able to drag Mike Lawler across the finish line in NY-17, even while Kamala won the district. **I’m counting on this grassroots team to help me make sure history doesn’t repeat itself.** There are no paths for Democrats to take back the House without beating Lawler. | | | Friend, Bishop Michael Burbidge of Arlington, Virginia wrote an official letter urging Catholics to **vote ****against** the Right to Reproductive Freedom Amendment and the Remove Constitutional Same-sex Marriage Ban Amendment. He then asked all priests in the Diocese to read the letter aloud at Mass, which serves more than 430,000 Catholics in 70 different parishes. **We join our partners at Catholics for Choice to call out this blatant religious overreach.** We see no need to give the fearmongering and unchecked disinformation the light of day. Instead, let’s set the record straight. The claims in Bishop Burbridge’s letter are nothing more than the bishop’s spin and not the truth. The hierarchy’s position does not reflect what ordinary Catholics know to be just. In reality:
* 6 in 10 Catholics believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases.
* Only 1 in 10 Catholics is aligned with the bishop’s extreme, total anti-abortion views.
* 68% of Catholics did not want to see _Roe v. Wade_ overturned.
* 1 in 4 abortion patients is Catholic.

Contrary to what the Catholic hierarchy wants you to believe, pro-choice Catholics are not alone. Far from it. Catholic history indicates that true Catholicism is based on a deep respect for each individual’s conscience — not a bishop’s demands — when making moral decisions. **With only 25 days until voting concludes in Virginia, we need to stop the spread of misinformation and make sure Virginians know how important it is to vote Yes on 1.** **[Can we count on you to chip in just $10 to the YES on 1 campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141019610/652280663/241827350?refcode=100926&sourceid=1052158&ms=100926&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNMDEvMS8xMTg5NjAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzE1NWZlMzgtZThjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=j9UJBZHE-hs01Exni2rCVa02Zrdf5A4w8Dtu_Kk9rgs=)**

clean_body: We won't let them spin the truth.| | | | | | | | | | | | | Friend, Bishop Michael Burbidge of Arlington, Virginia wrote an official letter urging Catholics to vote against the Right to Reproductive Freedom Amendment and the Remove Constitutional Same-sex Marriage Ban Amendment. He then asked all priests in the Diocese to read the letter aloud at Mass, which serves more than 430,000 Catholics in 70 different parishes. We join our partners at Catholics for Choice to call out this blatant religious overreach. We see no need to give the fearmongering and unchecked disinformation the light of day. Instead, let’s set the record straight. The claims in Bishop Burbridge’s letter are nothing more than the bishop’s spin and not the truth. The hierarchy’s position does not reflect what ordinary Catholics know to be just. In reality: 6 in 10 Catholics believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases. Only 1 in 10 Catholics is aligned with the bishop’s extreme, total anti-abortion views. 68% of Catholics did not want to see Roe v. Wade overturned. 1 in 4 abortion patients is Catholic. Contrary to what the Catholic hierarchy wants you to believe, pro-choice Catholics are not alone. Far from it. Catholic history indicates that true Catholicism is based on a deep respect for each individual’s conscience — not a bishop’s demands — when making moral decisions. With only 25 days until voting concludes in Virginia, we need to stop the spread of misinformation and make sure Virginians know how important it is to vote Yes on 1. = = Thank you for being in this fight. They want to...Abolish our bordersAbolish the electoral collegeAbolish IsraelAbolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in the "DSA!" platform)That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and onto ballots across the country.The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to every day still aren't buying it.I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it:71% of Americans reject socialism67% of Democrat voters reject socialism While 82% of Republican voters reject socialismBut here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one that looks the most powerful.And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and getting louder. The media is their megaphone. Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policiesNothing could be further from the truth. But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle.So, can I ask you a favor? Whatever your party affiliation is, can I ask you to stand with me against the daily barrage of hit-pieces But it will also send a message. It will show the truth that the "real numbers" are on our side here in Pennsylvania, as well as around the rest of America. You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down.Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me: "Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him: The Pennsylvania senator has long irked members of his own party" ~ Bloomberg If you'll stand with me today, I know we can show them that we're not backing down and that the real numbers are on the side of common sense and putting our country first.Thank you!John Fetterman P.S. - I'll bet you're more than a little surprised to get this email from me. So, I want to say thanks for setting aside party affiliation for a second and hearing me out. You see, I'm not a progressive. And I'm definitely not a Democratic Socialist. I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. It is a dangerous one.Common-sense people need to join together now to reject this vision before it's too late. | | | | | | Paid for by Fetterman for PA P.O Box 6061 Pittsburgh, PA 15211 |

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e6718593/VaHR0cHM6Ly9vZGIubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvSHJrNjhxejQ5Rg/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjEwMDk/LbmNsbXBMdUJNUQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNsNHJ1UUtiZjRiZDNscw/gasj5Aw/s5l3fb58143)

# Friend,
---
There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the **"Stop Nick Shirley Act"** means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law _actually_ does.
---
[](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Friend: **it makes it harder for anyone — me included — to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent.** I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; _this is just the beginning._ Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. **The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General** — the _one person_ in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Friend. That's the system protecting itself. **[Friend, will you make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, or $100 today to help keep independent journalists like me in the field?](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**
---
[ **Yes —****I'll****Help Keep Independent Journalists in the Field** ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't — daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. _They're right_ — and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. Here's something most people don't see, Friend: doing this work independently means there's no network paying for the flight to Sacramento, no legal department covering me if a state files a complaint over a story, no corporate budget for the cameras and editors it takes to get this footage in front of you. When I showed up at that rally, **Lincoln Media Foundation** was on site with their own journalists to cover it, because they understood what was actually at stake before most of the country did. _That’s why I’m partnering with Lincoln Media Foundation._ They understand how important it is to support independent journalists and help us keep doing the work without compromising what makes it independent in the _first place._ I’m grateful for their partnership and commitment, and **[every dollar you give to LMF goes directly toward keeping reporters like me in the field](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** – helping cover travel, equipment, and the costs that come with confronting people on camera instead of reading a press release about them.

**Since LMF is a 501(c)3, your gift is tax-deductible** , and it can be made anonymously if that's what you'd prefer.
---
[ **Yes —****I'll****Fund Independent Investigations** ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
Friend, they can pass all the laws they want. They can try to prevent people like me from exposing their corruption, that’s why it crucial to support independent journalists like myself. They are creating laws to silence free speech — and that’s why we need to continue the fight and I need your support. People like you decide this work is worth funding, and it helps me continue! **[Will you help LMF keep me — and journalists like me — in the field with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give today?](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**
---
For the truth,

_**Nick Shirley**_
---
[ **Help Support Nick’s Work** ](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)
---
P.S. — A California assemblyman is already asking the DOJ to intervene against this law. That tells you how serious this is. **[A tax-deductible gift today helps LMF keep me and other independent journalists in the field while this fight plays out.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**

**Friday, October 9, 2026 -**_****_
_**Palestine** : Israeli attacks kill nine Palestinians in Gaza on Thursday and Friday. Israeli settlers carry out at least 19 attacks across the occupied West Bank, targeting olive harvesters and property. Palestinian Authority plans to postpone November elections until September 2027. Nearly 22,000 Palestinian children killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza over three years, with more than 71,000 orphaned. Israeli military actions linked to deaths of at least 24 captives in Gaza, CNN investigation finds. Colombia to open Israel embassy in Jerusalem next week._
_**Yemen** : Three killed in Ansarallah attacks on Saudi airport. Saudi-led coalition destroys three Ansarallah missile launchers as airstrikes reported in Sana'a._
_**Iran** : President Donald Trump says U.S. will not attack Iran before the November 3 midterms. Russian President Vladimir Putin tells Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian Russia will "do everything" to help end the U.S.-led war. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps strikes LPG tanker, threatens to target vessels beyond Strait of Hormuz. At least 81 U.S. military aircraft lost or damaged in war against Iran, costing up to $3.3 billion. U.S. sanctions 17 more vessels carrying Iranian oil._
_**Lebanon:** Israeli forces uproot olive trees in southern Lebanon amid airstrikes and artillery shelling._
_**U.S.** : ICE agent shoots and wounds man in New York City with 5-year-old in car. Trump disclosed 517 securities trades in August, including up to $25 million in Meta and SpaceX debt bought two days before a space policy signing. Pentagon to livestream firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter. FBI deletes video attacking Democrats. Trump administration suspends Microsoft, seven other firms from green card program, alleging fraud. Michigan Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers leaves door open to AIPAC support in Michigan Senate race._
_**International:** Navi Pillay, who led UN inquiry finding Israel committed genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize. Ukrainian strikes kill two in Russia's Belgorod; Russian bombs kill one in Zaporizhzhia. No survivors from sunken ship off Bulgaria. Ethiopia tells UN Security Council it will defend itself against Eritrean "all-out invasion." Drone strikes hit Eritrean forces inside northern Ethiopia, conflict monitor says. Brazilian justice issues arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro weeks before runoff. France pledges 3,000 extra teachers as student protests continue; stun grenades banned from marches. Prison fight in Sinaloa kills 10, including a minor. U.S. judge orders Trump administration to facilitate return of Egyptian man deported to Equatorial Guinea. UN Security Council extends Sudan sanctions by two months. South Africa withdraws asylum intake directive after anti-migrant protests turn violent. International Criminal Court judges rule former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte fit to stand trial; trial opens November 30._

* * *
# Palestine
* **Israeli attacks kill nine Palestinians in Gaza on Thursday and Friday:** Israeli forces killed at least nine Palestinians and wounded several others across the Gaza Strip on Thursday and Friday, according to WAFA.
* On Friday, Israeli troops [opened fire](https://substack.com/redirect/3342bc16-ae0d-48b8-b7d1-b4a9f83eb615?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Palestinians east of the Maghazi and Bureij refugee camps in central Gaza, killing one man who was shot in the neck and wounding others.
* On Thursday, eight Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks, including two men in a drone strike on a vehicle near the Jordanian field hospital in southwest Gaza City, a woman in artillery shelling northwest of the city, and two people, including a child, in a drone strike on a home in the Sabra neighborhood.
* **Israeli settlers carry out at least 19 attacks across the occupied West Bank, targeting olive harvesters and property:** Israeli settlers [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/7ba2c55b-83e2-4ceb-adfd-32048f0020b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at least 19 attacks across the occupied West Bank on Friday, assaulting olive harvesters, burning vehicles and trees, stealing livestock, and forcing farmers off their land, according to the Palestinian Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission. Israeli forces also fired live ammunition and tear gas at farmers, confiscated agricultural equipment, and conducted raids and arrests.
* **Nablus:** Settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/0729bc31-dd21-410a-b32c-f91b2cbdedff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) olive harvesters across several villages, including Tal, Jamma'in, Qusra, Beita, Sebastia, Beit Furik, and Deir Sharaf, forcing farmers off their land. They burned a vehicle in Tal and uprooted more than 50 olive trees in Qusra, where Israeli soldiers fired tear gas and stun grenades, sparking fires.
* **Ramallah:** Settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/49782eea-7b06-48f3-9632-c90cff1358dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) farmers in Deir Sudan and Deir Ibzi, stealing crops and forcing them off their land. Armed settlers stole 20 sheep in Ein Qiniya under Israeli military protection, while a man and his child were assaulted and their vehicle stolen in Yabroud. Two people were injured in settler attacks in Deir Ibzi.
* **Salfit:** Israeli soldiers and settlers [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/516f3fc2-d672-403d-9245-6609c8a101a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) live ammunition to drive farmers from their land in Deir Ballut, while settlers injured a farmer in Kafr ad-Dik. Settlers also burned olive trees in Wadi Al-Shaer.
* **Hebron:** A 79-year-old woman was [injured](https://substack.com/redirect/806cff17-a43a-4357-9991-e5c6bc202db2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after settlers unleashed dogs on olive harvesters in Birin. Israeli forces confiscated a school transport vehicle, two tractors and animal feed in Masafer Yatta, and arrested nine Palestinians in Hebron, including the director of the Ibrahimi Mosque.
* **Jenin:** Settlers [cut down](https://substack.com/redirect/2c8e737f-d337-4df3-a893-101ef240e266?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 100 olive trees in Al-Mughayyir village overnight Thursday.
* **Palestinian Authority plans to postpone November elections until September 2027:** Palestinian Authority Vice President Hussein Al-Sheikh [informed](https://substack.com/redirect/632badd4-bbe9-4538-86f3-074319618204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) France that legislative elections scheduled for November 28 will be postponed, potentially until September 2027, citing worsening political, security and economic conditions in Gaza and the occupied West Bank, according to an October 8 letter seen by Reuters.
* The letter pointed to a number of causes for the postponement, including expectations of an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza, the deployment of international forces and Palestinian police, curbs on Israeli annexation and settler violence, and the release of nearly $7 billion in Palestinian funds withheld by Israel, that had not materialized.
* Palestinians have not held legislative elections since 2006 or presidential elections since 2005, and Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas has ruled by decree since his presidential mandate expired in 2009. Hamas won a majority over Fatah in the January 2006 Palestinian parliamentary elections, prompting severe Israeli economic and military measures against the Hamas-led government.
* **Nearly 22,000 Palestinian children killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza over three years, with more than 71,000 orphaned:** Israeli attacks killed at least 21,976 Palestinian children in Gaza over the past three years, an average of one child every 71 minutes, according to a report by Gaza's Health Ministry.
* Among those killed were 5,444 children under five and 1,125 infants under one year old. Another 45,569 children have been injured, including 1,134 who have undergone amputations, while 71,846 have been orphaned.
* The ministry also reported 612 children killed while seeking food or medicine, 466 deaths from malnutrition, including 157 children, and 2,027 patients who died while awaiting medical evacuation, including 264 children.
* The report found that all 38 hospitals and 158 primary healthcare centers in Gaza have been targeted, with 19 hospitals and 64 healthcare centers out of service. It also documented 1,723 healthcare workers killed and 216 ambulances targeted.
* **Israeli military actions linked to deaths of at least 24 captives in Gaza, CNN investigation finds:** At least 24 of the 40 Israeli captives who died in captivity in Gaza had [deaths linked to Israeli military actions](https://substack.com/redirect/8c13f100-6e3b-412d-b1ce-562063611768?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including airstrikes and ground operations, as well as military advances that prompted their captors to kill them, a CNN investigation found. At least 11 were killed directly by Israeli military operations.
* The investigation, based on interviews with captive families and Israeli officials, also found that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu repeatedly delayed ceasefire negotiations, including a potential deal in July 2024 that officials said could have saved lives.
* **Colombia to open Israel embassy in Jerusalem next week:** Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar [said](https://substack.com/redirect/ece83533-8081-4f83-80e7-6d3f41f43700?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday that Colombia will inaugurate its embassy to Israel in Jerusalem "next Wednesday," as he touted expanding ties with Latin America. A Colombian Foreign Ministry official told AFP that Foreign Minister Omar Bula Escobar will travel to Jerusalem on Sunday ahead of the opening.
* Abelardo De la Espriella, Colombia's new right-wing president, promised close relations with Israel during his campaign. Once elected, he restored diplomatic ties with Israel that left-wing President Gustavo Petro had severed as a result of Israel's genocide in Gaza.
* Israel occupied East Jerusalem in 1967 and annexed it in 1980 in a move largely unrecognized internationally, claiming the entire city as its capital, while Palestinians seek Jerusalem as the capital of a future Palestinian state.

# Yemen
* **Three killed in Ansarallah attacks on Saudi airport:** Three Saudi citizens were killed and several others injured in two Ansarallah [attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/d5e3a263-fe11-4452-8033-3f9e551ef705?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Thursday, according to Saudi Arabia's Civil Aviation Authority.
* One attack targeted airport facilities, while the other struck a Saudi Airlines aircraft on the ground, killing an airline employee and damaging the plane, which had no passengers aboard.
* Hundreds of flights to Riyadh were cancelled, though flight cancellations fell from 335 on Thursday to at least 103 on Friday as the airport worked to restore normal operations. The EU Aviation Safety Agency also expanded its warning against flying over parts of Saudi Arabia, citing Ansarallah' demonstrated ability to strike targets deeper inside the kingdom, including Riyadh.
* **Saudi-led coalition destroys three Ansarallah missile launchers as airstrikes reported in Sana 'a: **The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed three missile launch platforms used by Ansarallah, releasing [footage](https://substack.com/redirect/91c10265-8718-4323-b1f7-b3e854b57af6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the strikes.
* Separately, Ansarallah-affiliated Al-Masira [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/ed919e66-9686-4cd5-a9b4-56a9603d1c89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) airstrikes on Yemen's capital, Sana'a, without immediately providing details on casualties or damage.

# Iran
* **Trump says U.S. will not attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms** : President Donald Trump [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/ab01c091-13f7-406f-a6a1-419a412b80cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Truth Social Thursday that "we will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the Midterm Elections to be held in the United States on November 3rd."
* He justified this further in the post by claiming that Iran is "in very bad condition, both Economically and Militarily."
* He has repeatedly tied the war to the midterms, saying he believes Iran's leaders are trying to hold out through November to hurt Republicans, and that he expects to win the war after the vote.
* **Putin tells Iran 's Pezeshkian Russia will "do everything" to help end the U.S.-led war: **Russian President Vladimir**** Putin [met](https://substack.com/redirect/2693cdf8-32c5-4c06-8875-f963a1b3d335?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in Turkmenistan on Thursday, ahead of the Commonwealth of Independent States summit, and said, "On our part, we are ready to do everything we can to help you resolve this situation," according to the Interfax news service.
* The Russian president commended Iran for making "real efforts to end the conflict, which broke out through no fault of its own," and noted a "positive evolution" in Iran-Russia ties.
* On Wednesday, Putin told Pezeshkian in a call that Moscow is ready to mediate between the U.S. and Iran, Iran's IRNA reported.
* Pezeshkian said talks with the U.S. to end the war could succeed only if based on "mutual respect and reciprocal commitments" and free from "pressure and threats," speaking at the summit on Friday.
* **Iran 's IRGC strikes LPG tanker, threatens to target vessels beyond Strait of Hormuz: **Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) [said](https://substack.com/redirect/bec1748d-683a-40c4-9849-594ad2440fb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it struck a large LPG tanker named NV Sunshine attempting to transit an "illegal route" south of the Strait of Hormuz, causing a major fire in its engine room and propulsion system, according to Tasnim news agency.
* The IRGC subsequently warned that vessels using unauthorized routes would face "punitive measures" even outside the strait, threatening to pursue them "throughout the region" and warning against following "deception of the American aggressors."
* **At least 81 U.S. military aircraft lost or damaged in war against Iran, costing up to $3.3 billion:** At least 81 U.S. military aircraft were lost or damaged during Operation Epic Fury, Washington's military campaign against Iran launched on February 28, according to a Congressional Budget Office report.
* The report estimated losses of $1.9 billion to $3.3 billion as of August 1, including 12 F-15E fighter jets, one F-35A, seven KC-135 refueling aircraft and 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones.
* **U.S. sanctions 17 more vessels carrying Iranian oil:** The U.S. Treasury Department [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/54247f3e-64db-4655-be89-b53af61d93b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sanctions on 17 additional vessels linked to Iran's so-called "shadow fleet" as part of its "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign to cut Tehran's oil revenues amid the ongoing war.
* The vessels, registered across more than a dozen jurisdictions, have transported millions of barrels of Iranian crude and petroleum products, according to the Treasury.
* A U.S. official said Iran has stopped loading and unloading oil because of the American blockade of its ports, while shipping data firm Kpler reported no Iranian crude loaded for export since August 25.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli forces uproot olive trees in southern Lebanon amid airstrikes and artillery shelling:**
* **Nabatieh:** Israeli infantry accompanied by a D9 bulldozer advanced to within 50 meters of a Lebanese army position in Zawtar Al-Gharbiyeh, continuing to [uproot olive trees](https://substack.com/redirect/4583698b-9b78-47c4-a79f-db4e6d4632eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an operation that began Thursday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* Israeli warplanes also struck the outskirts of Kfar Tebnit, following overnight shelling near Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, Kfar Tebnit and Mayfadoun.
* **Marjayoun:** An Israeli Merkava tank advanced from Khiam toward the Ibl al-Saqi spring, with Israeli forces firing machine guns toward the surrounding area. Artillery also struck Wadi Al-Salouqi.
* **Tyre (Sour):** Israeli forces shelled Mansouri, Majdal Zoun and surrounding valleys overnight.
* **Bint Jbeil:** Israeli shelling [targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/e9faad40-b512-4bd0-bdc0-f490d3070db9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Wadi Zibqin and areas near Baraachit and Hadatha.

# U.S. News
* **ICE agent shoots and wounds man in New York City with 5-year-old in car:** An ICE agent [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/60ebff6b-20cc-4e08-a4ac-748472c277d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) seven rounds into a car around 4 p.m. Thursday in New York City's Marble Hill neighborhood, wounding **Oscar Belgal** , 28, in the neck below the left ear, according to New York City Police Commissioner **Jessica Tisch**. A 5-year-old boy believed to be his son was in the back seat and was not injured.
* Surveillance video of the incident showed a plainclothes officer approaching the driver's window with his gun drawn before the car began to move, Tisch noted.
* DHS said agents were trying to arrest an undocumented Dominican immigrant with a grand larceny conviction, but did not name Belgal, explain why the agent fired, or whether the agent knew a child was in the car. The New York City Police Department said its officers were not involved.
* New York City Mayor **Zohran Mamdani** called the shooting "an outrage," saying "there is no justification for what we have seen today." Mamdani also claimed that during a two hour call with President **Donald Trump** and Homeland Security Secretary **Markwayne Mullin** they refused to release Belgal, whom ICE took away in an unmarked vehicle. New York Governor **Kathy Hochul** said she urged Trump and Mullin to halt ICE operations in New York and asked that any body-camera footage be released.
* Protesters gathered at the scene and outside Allen Hospital, where officers scuffled with them and at least one person was detained. Incoming Rep. Darializa Avila Chevalier [was on the frontlines of the protest and thrown to the ground](https://substack.com/redirect/a55773b0-1c07-406c-a2c0-732409a1ae99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Immigration agents have shot at least two dozen people across the country since January 2025, killing six, including three U.S. citizens.
* **Trump disclosed 517 securities trades in August, including up to $25 million in Meta and SpaceX debt bought two days before a space policy signing:** Trump's August financial disclosure [lists](https://substack.com/redirect/9c06ff26-20f7-4965-b3d7-1b840504488b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 517 purchases and sales totaling roughly $74.3 million to $273.3 million, according to a CNBC analysis, with purchases of at least $44.2 million and sales of at least $30.1 million. The largest was an August 21 purchase of $5 million to $25 million in Meta stock.
* On August 18, Trump's accounts bought $1 million to $5 million in senior unsecured SpaceX notes at 5.35 percent, maturing in 2031. Two days later, he signed a national space transportation policy calling for more than 1,000 launches and reentries a year by 2030. SpaceX is a major Pentagon contractor and NASA launch provider.
* On August 26, his portfolio bought $15,001 to $50,000 of Tyson Foods the same day he signed a proclamation expanding low-tariff imports of lean beef trimmings. The disclosure does not show whether the trade came before or after the signing.
* Trump's 2025 annual disclosure showed more than 21,000 trades across eight accounts holding at least $858 million, which contrasts starkly with the 86 stock transactions he made during the first year of his first term, in 2017.
* **Pentagon to livestream firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter:** War Secretary **Pete Hegseth**[told](https://substack.com/redirect/59f1a710-5674-4d11-b09a-c4042f66eb12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Real America's Voice on Thursday that **Nidal Hasan** , convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, "is gonna get a firing squad of soldiers. As it should be." He added, "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it. That it's public. Because people need to understand that there's serious consequences for these types of things." Hasan is scheduled to be executed December 3 at Fort Hood.
* The Pentagon later released a statement confirming that the execution will be livestreamed.
* The U.S. hasn't held a public execution since 1936, when **Rainey Bethea** was hanged in Kentucky. It would be the first US military execution since 1961. The last military firing-squad execution was in 1945.
* **FBI deletes video attacking Democrats** : An FBI video [posted](https://substack.com/redirect/96273efb-1031-4ad0-ad2d-998a1cac915a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday on its rapid response X account labeled prominent Democrats, among them **Kamala Harris** , Reps. **Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez** and **Ilhan Omar** , former Rep.**Cori Bush** and Michigan Senate nominee **Abdul El-Sayed** , as part of "the DEFUND THE POLICE crowd," and accused them of seeking to "let criminals run wild while cops take a backseat." The FBI has since deleted the post and did not respond to a request for comment.
* Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington (CREW) filed a complaint with the Office of Special Counsel, which investigates violations of the Hatch Act, which limits the partisan political activities of federal executive branch employees (excluding the President).
* CREW CEO **Donald Sherman** said in an X post on Thursday that although the video does not tell viewers how to vote, its message that the candidates' policies "failed" is "advocacy against their election." He added that tagging El-Sayed as "Progressive Democrat, Senate Nominee" "clearly invokes the election."
* **Trump administration suspends Microsoft, seven other firms from green card program, alleging fraud** : Vice President **JD Vance** [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/8f1acb12-ab84-476e-8dd0-21deddbe808b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday that the administration is suspending Microsoft, Adobe and tech consulting firms Cognizant, Infosys, Tata, Wipro, HCL and Capgemini from the H-1B visa program that allows foreign workers to apply for green cards.
* Vance accused the firms of hiding the job offers they are required to first publicly announce in the U.S. in "small town newspapers." He also claimed that Microsoft laid off 6,000 American workers last year while obtaining 6,300 H-1B visas and almost 3,000 green cards.
* Microsoft said about 80 percent of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were to extend or change the status of existing employees, and that the rest were for people already legally in the U.S.
* Vance also singled out nine universities for investigation over J-1 visa use: Harvard, Yale, Stanford, Brown, Pittsburgh, UC Davis, Caltech, Arizona State and MIT. MIT, Brown and Pitt said they had received subpoenas related to this investigation.
* The announcement came hours before Trump awarded the National Medal of Technology and Innovation to Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella.
* **Rogers leaves door open to AIPAC support in Michigan Senate race** : Michigan GOP Senate nominee **Mike Rogers** [signaled](https://substack.com/redirect/df7a016a-83e5-4d27-afdf-589970f36b22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a Thursday debate that he would accept AIPAC's backing against Democrat **Abdul El-Sayed** , saying "anybody that wants to help my campaign stop" El-Sayed, "I'll take all of that help."
* AIPAC's super PAC, United Democracy Project, spent more than $30 million against El-Sayed in the Michigan Democratic primary. AdImpact data show the group does not appear to have bought TV ads since.
* An August Axios report said Rogers' allies had asked AIPAC not to advertise for him, and that the group scrapped an anti-El-Sayed video a day after Rogers spoke with AIPAC board Chair Michael Tuchin. Rogers believed, according to Axios, that the group might be a liability to him in the general election, though around the time of his initial rupture with the group, he reportedly attended AIPAC-hosted fundraisers in California in August.

# Other International News
* **Ukrainian strikes kill two in Russia 's Belgorod; Russian bombs kill one in Zaporizhzhia**: A Ukrainian strike [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/4715042e-40c6-4102-b0d5-cbf3dbd2eb82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two people and injured four, including a child, in the Russian border region of Belgorod on Friday, the Russian news agency TASS reported.
* A separate drone attack on the central region of Kaluga injured nine.
* In Ukraine, Russian bombs reportedly killed one person and injured seven, including a child, in Zaporizhzhia, according to the region's governor.
* **No survivors from sunken ship off Bulgaria:** Bulgarian authorities said they had found no survivors from the recently sunken Alfa Watan ship, one of two commercial vessels sunk by a drone in the Black Sea on Tuesday. Both of the sunken ships were managed by Turkey-based companies, according to Equasis.
* A Syrian customs official [told](https://substack.com/redirect/034079d5-f2fa-4ffe-8e69-20e07ae67b8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) AFP on Thursday nine of the ten missing crew members on the recently sunken Alfa Watan were Syrians and the tenth was Egyptian.

* **Navi Pillay, who led UN inquiry finding Israel committed genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize:** South African jurist Navi Pillay, 85, was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize on Friday as "as a driving force in the development of an international system of law and order." A former UN human rights chief, ICC judge and anti-apartheid advocate, Pillay chaired the UN inquiry that concluded last year that Israel committed genocide in Gaza.
* Pillay learned of the award at a legal conference in Nuremberg, Germany, where Nazi leaders were tried after World War II. "The last thing I did is the delivery of the report on Gaza, naming what's happening there as genocide," she [said](https://substack.com/redirect/dc047408-1a1c-4a6f-9de6-08f8596109d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* In response to the award, Israel's Foreign Ministry [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/8683a3e3-f98c-493d-ab02-7a39e38b29ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Pillay of spreading "lies, hatred, and blood libels" and promoting what it called the "genoLIE." "Now that the Nobel commission has rewarded the biggest lie of the 21st century, Joseph Goebbels is certainly applauding from hell," it added, invoking the Nazi propaganda minister.

* **Ethiopia tells UN Security Council it will defend itself against Eritrean "all-out invasion"**: Ethiopia [said](https://substack.com/redirect/daea2108-136e-4728-9958-e5efec615f64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a letter to the UN Security Council that it has no option but to defend itself against what it described as an "all out invasion" by Eritrea, in its first official statement on reported Eritrean incursions earlier this week, according to Reuters.
* Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos wrote that Eritrean forces, "including mechanized units," have deployed up to 60 km (37 miles) into northern Ethiopia. He called the Eritrean incursions a "matter of public record" and "a blatant act of aggression that engages Ethiopia's inherent right to self-defense."
* Witnesses told Reuters this week they saw Eritrean soldiers in northern Ethiopia, days after the two countries severed diplomatic ties. Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of backing a rebel alliance fighting federal troops since September 23 in Tigray, Amhara and Afar.
* **Drone strikes hit Eritrean forces inside northern Ethiopia, conflict monitor says** : Drone strikes, believed to have been carried out by Ethiopia's military, [targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/7c688524-3449-4ef7-8bf5-2f4e8fab7aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Eritrean military vehicles near Adigrat as they withdrew from positions in Tigray on Wednesday and Thursday, according to the U.S.-based conflict monitor ACLED.
* Eritrean soldiers crossed into Ethiopia on Wednesday, advanced dozens of kilometers, then pulled back under heavy bombardment, the conflict monitor added. Two sources, a diplomat and a conflict expert in contact with both sides, reported that Eritrean forces were moving north but said it was unclear whether they were leaving Ethiopia or redeploying within it.
* **Brazilian justice issues arrest warrant for Eduardo Bolsonaro weeks before runoff** : Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/061a9726-f147-4063-8ee4-a2b396c3b77f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an arrest warrant Thursday for Eduardo Bolsonaro, brother of presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro, ordering him to begin serving a four-year sentence immediately. Moraes cancelled Bolsonaro's passport and told federal police to arrest him should he return from Texas, where he currently resides,
* The Supreme Court convicted Eduardo in June of lobbying the U.S. to interfere in the trial of his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, alleging that he lobbied for the U.S. to impose sanctions on Brazilian officials and tariffs on Brazilian exports.
* Jair Bolsonaro was sentenced in September 2025 to 27 years for plotting a coup, in an investigation chaired by de Moraes, whom the Bolsonaro family regards as a political enemy.
* The presidential election runoff between President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro is set for October 25.
* **France pledges 3,000 extra teachers as student protests continue; stun grenades banned from marches:** French Education Minister Edouard Geffray [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/4384db01-208b-429e-9ff7-82e83012bbc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that 3,000 teachers would be sent to high-priority schools by Tuesday, with a "few hundred more" to be recruited, after weeks of mass protests that have gripped the country. Nearly 71,500 people protested across France on Thursday, with 24,500 protesters reported in Paris alone, France's Interior Ministry said. More than 500 people were arrested.
* Economy Minister Roland Lescure added, following the 1.4% increase in money allocated for education in France's 2027 budget, that there was "room" to meet the demands of the protesters for more resources.
* The protests began September 21 at a school in a deprived Paris area. Initiated by high school students, the demonstrations have grown to include university students and trade unions. Demands have included more teachers, renovated buildings and fewer classroom hours.
* Police have been accused of using excessive force, with the use of stun grenades being banned after a teenager lost his hand to a police stun grenade earlier this week.
* **Prison fight in Sinaloa kills 10, including a minor:** A fight inside the El Castillo Penitentiary Centre in Mazatlan, Sinaloa, [left](https://substack.com/redirect/4cc612b5-1bde-45de-9e41-de0590c0d29d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) nine prisoners and a family visitor dead and 16 prisoners injured, state authorities said Thursday. A state official also added that the family visitor killed in the fight was a minor.
* Mexican security forces reportedly moved into the prison, and officials report that the prison is now "under control."
* Sinaloa is a battleground for warring factions of the Sinaloa drug cartel, and the State Department advises Americans not to visit it. Officials have not said whether the violence was linked to that conflict.
* **U.S. judge orders Trump administration to facilitate return of Egyptian man deported to Equatorial Guinea** : U.S. District Judge John C. Hinderaker [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/72b4b8b9-9f3b-46e6-b64a-66a974e76afd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday that the Department of Homeland Security must facilitate the release of Ahmed Soliman from custody in Equatorial Guinea and his return to the U.S., Reuters reported.
* Soliman was deported to the central African country this year under a third-country deportation deal. Last month he said Equatorial Guinean police treated him roughly, and video obtained by Reuters showed officers pulling firearms on migrants, including him. After Reuters published this story, he was taken into custody and has been held incommunicado at a gendarmerie station.
* Soliman told an immigration judge last year he feared being killed in Egypt because he is gay. Reuters has documented 40 cases of migrants granted U.S. protection over persecution for their LGBT status who were deported to African countries that criminalize same-sex relations or have been described by the State Department as hostile to LGBT people.
* **UN Security Council extends Sudan sanctions by two months:** The Security Council [voted](https://substack.com/redirect/2f9e38bc-7570-47d5-abc5-1b726c922cd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unanimously on Thursday to extend sanctions on arms sales to warring factions in Darfur until December 11, 2026, after the United States withdrew a draft that would have broadened the scope of the sanctions to cover the whole of Sudan and all of its warring parties.
* Several member states reportedly wanted a standard one-year renewal of the Darfur embargo, which date back to 2005, without changes. Russia, which holds a veto, notably opposed the U.S. proposal to widen the sanctions regime.
* **South Africa withdraws asylum intake directive after anti-migrant protests turn violent:** South Africa's Home Affairs Department [said](https://substack.com/redirect/36c7aa4b-3c9c-49fb-bf39-b42a661789c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday it had withdrawn a directive allowing it to resume processing asylum applications, a day after anti-migrant protests turned violent in Johannesburg and Durban.
* The directive would have implemented a July 7 Constitutional Court ruling that found that asylum seekers could not be denied access to the system solely on "procedural grounds," meaning primarily that those who had entered the country illegally would not be automatically disqualified from asylum. The department said the proposed directive was withdrawn after the number of asylum applications overwhelmed refugee reception offices within days of its announcement, putting officials at risk and threatening public safety and order
* On Thursday, rioters torched 14 vehicles in Durban and 10 in Johannesburg's Soweto township, and foreign-owned shops were looted. A months-long surge in anti-immigrant protests in South Africa has strained its relations with other African countries and forced thousands of foreign nationals to leave.
* **ICC judges rule Duterte fit to stand trial; trial opens Nov. 30:** International Criminal Court judges [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/b7ab7435-64ab-4529-bce5-2d8cc1356058?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a September 28 decision, announced Thursday, that former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, 81, is fit to stand trial on crimes against humanity charges tied to his drug war. An independent expert panel found he "has the capacity to understand the charges," follow proceedings, understand the evidence, and discuss his defense with lawyers. He will be asked to enter a plea when the trial opens November 30.
